name: One real native mission turn; preserve both failed and successful history

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.EnemyProgress()=='MISSION','mission window needs an active native mission'); local s=b.ReadEnemy(); local m=assert(GameInfo.UnitOperations['UNITOPERATION_SPY_NEUTRALIZE_GOVERNOR'],'native neutralize operation missing'); assert(s.spy.operation==m.Index or s.spy.operation==m.Hash,'mission window requires native neutralization'); assert(s.spy.present and type(s.spy.remaining)=='number' and s.spy.remaining>=1,'mission window needs at least one native turn remaining'); return 'one native turn verified'
local stage=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.EnemyProgress(); if stage=='FAILED' then error('native neutralization failed; checkpoint preserves the failed mission') end; return stage
